title: Speed at point C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_C = sqrt(gR) = 2 m/s using centripetal force condition at the top of the loop.

title: Work-energy for v_B
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem between B and C, accounting for gravitational work to find v_B = 2√5 m/s.

title: Distance x_PB
description: Essential: Sets up and solves work-energy from P to B with electric work and friction loss to obtain x_PB = 2 m.

title: Maximum KE position
description: Important: Identifies that maximum KE occurs where net tangential force is zero, at angle θ = arctan(qE/mg) = 45° from vertical.

title: Maximum KE value
description: Important: Calculates maximum kinetic energy using work-energy from B to the 45° point, obtaining approximately 1.2 J.

title: Forgetting friction on AB
description: Pitfall: Omits friction work term (μmgx_PB) when applying work-energy theorem on the horizontal track.

title: Centripetal force error at C
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect force balance at point C (e.g., includes electric force in radial direction or wrong normal force).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations and presents final answers with correct units.
